reviews.title: Compatible with LGA 1366 CPU as advertized!
reviews.comment: I ordered this Dracaena CPU water cooling setup to replace an existing water cooling unit on an old Intel-based (LGA 1366 socket) gaming rig.  So glad I gave it a try!  It's working like a champ, and helped  resurrect my old PC.  A search on my motherboard/CPU combo revealed I had an LGA1366 CPU socket design.  This is a really outdated Intel processor design, but the machine was perfectly fine, other than the failed cooling system.  Some people suggested that water cooling systems were no longer made for old CPUs, but this Dracaena system said it was compatible with a variety of LGA socket types, including my old LGA 1366.  With the included adapter brackets and screws, I was able to secure this new cooling hardware on my old CPU, and it's keeping the CPU at temperatures lower than I'd previously seen!  I thought the brackets would interfere with some of the transistors on the motherboard, and the CPU hold-down arm, but the included brackets had just enough offset to clear the adjacent hardware.  I was pleasantly surprised.  The screws that hold the pump to the CPU are spring loaded, so they keep tension on the CPU once you apply the thermal paste and screw it in place.  Fan is relatively quiet as well.  Your experience may vary, but in my case, it's a winner!  I can't really comment on the LED lighting system.  My old motherboard didn't have an LED plug/port.  It cycles through a rainbow of colors, and I can't seem to change the scheme with the remote control.  But I think that's a limitation of my system, not the Dracaena unit.  But the lights are not a priority to me.  I'm just glad it's keeping my CPU cool, and I can keep my old system chugging along!
reviews.author: Ron Burgundy

reviews.title: Great Deal for the Quality
reviews.comment:
This is a great performing and versatile pump, radiator coil, and controller combination that has an easy to use remote included.  All the cables and mounting components that you should need are included in the box for the compatible cpus. There is even a syringe of thermal paste. I found it really all-inclusive when assembling and hooking up.
Although the smallest version of this cooler, with just a single 120mm fan and radiator combo, this system brings plenty of cooling capacity to your setup. The cooling effect is almost immediate in my experience, too, so the cpu temperature doesn’t get a chance to become too high.
The installation of the pump onto the mounting brackets is misassembly-proof due to notches in the pump body so that you cannot install the metal brackets the wrong way. It takes a bit of patience to align the brackets, but this isn’t intended to be a clumsy and loose installation. The components are high quality and fit snug.
The 120mm PWM fan generates very little noise and that is really only noticeable with the higher speeds. LED lights in the fan synchronize with the pump so you get a great dancing color display from both.
The controller board LED cable can be either connected to the motherboard or not, if you’d like to use the included remote instead for lighting control. And, there are 6 ports of each, 12v 4-pin Fan and 5v 3-pin LED, on the controller for plenty of devices. There is even a connector to tie the case switch into the board for single button lighting control. To minimize space and allow versatile installation, the board doesn’t have a bulky case and includes a pre-installed adhesive foam backing. Just peel and stick. Mine stuck solidly on the first try.
There are several programmed lighting effects and repeat patterns, beyond the typical single color look, and different light brightness levels. So, enough options to keep from getting bored.
To top it off, the customer support is great with troubleshooting any installation and use challenges not covered in the paper manual. This was a welcome bonus when I had an issue with the LED lighting that turned out to be an installation error on my part. Dracaena made sure I was able to get the system operating properly and that is often lacking in other company’s support.
Overall, this was a great deal for the quality of the components, easy of assembly, and thoroughness of customer support.
reviews.author: Peter
